long_biography.plain_text:
Arriving at Princeton from post-war Austria with a scholarship and little money, Gerhard R. Andlinger supported himself through several campus jobs. He studied economics and Arabic, earned an MBA at Harvard, served in the United States Army, then developed turnaround expertise at McKinsey, ITT, Esterline and Levitt & Sons.

That experience shaped Andlinger & Company. Because he began with limited capital and refused outside equity, Andlinger targeted distressed businesses where managerial skill mattered more than money. As capital accumulated, he expanded into international acquisitions and technology ventures. At Princeton, a $100 million gift created a centre for energy and the environment; he chaired its advisory council and pressed for research linking engineering, policy and business.
long_biography.html:
Arriving at Princeton from post-war Austria with a scholarship and little money, Gerhard R. Andlinger supported himself through several campus jobs. He studied economics and Arabic, earned an MBA at Harvard, served in the United States Army, then developed turnaround expertise at McKinsey, ITT, Esterline and Levitt & Sons.

That experience shaped Andlinger & Company. Because he began with limited capital and refused outside equity, Andlinger targeted distressed businesses where managerial skill mattered more than money. As capital accumulated, he expanded into international acquisitions and technology ventures. At Princeton, a $100 million gift created a centre for energy and the environment; he chaired its advisory council and pressed for research linking engineering, policy and business.
